title: Charon ferryman myth comes from the Epic of Gilgamesh

tellings.quote: Underworld the river sticks that came from the Epic of gilgames that was the oldest recorded record of that

plain: The Greek myth of Charon, the ferryman who carries the dead across the river Styx into the underworld, came from the Epic of Gilgamesh, according to a researcher named Matt LaCroix, who calls Gilgamesh "the oldest recorded record of that." He tells Michels this without naming a single source, though he credits the British Museum's 1920 translation by E. A. Wallis Budge, The Babylonian Story of the Deluge and the Epic of Gilgamish, and a work called The Epic of Humanity. If true, a central Greek picture of death would trace back to ancient Mesopotamia.
